title: PCForge
description: A full-stack, cross-platform e-commerce and custom PC building ecosystem. Customers design rigs with real-time hardware compatibility validation, five LangGraph AI agents recommend specs and reserve inventory, and store technicians review builds in dedicated assembly workbenches — with RMA and service scheduling built in.
long-description: PCForge is a full-stack, cross-platform platform modelled on the enthusiast computer retail industry. Customers design custom rigs on a Flutter mobile app with live compatibility validation, autonomous LangGraph AI agents recommend specifications and reserve inventory, store technicians review builds in a React web portal, and after-sales workflows handle RMA and appointment scheduling.
image-captions: Staff dashboard — operational KPIs and action queue
Custom Build Clearance — PSU headroom and compatibility review
features: Interactive custom PC builder — live wattage summation and CPU / motherboard socket matching (AM5, AM4, LGA1700)
RAM DDR generation verification and form-factor clearance checks, with one-tap checkout and automatic component reservation
5 specialised LangGraph agents: Requirement, Inventory, PC Build, Order Planning and After-Sales
Multi-key Gemini cascading failover — up to 6 keys with exponential backoff and health tracking
Store operations portal — KPI metrics, build review queue with compatibility meters, inventory adjusters, order fulfilment and service intake
Branded EmailJS notifications for build approvals, order fulfilment and service appointments
Flutter Material 3 mobile client — faceted catalog search, hardware camera scanner, appointment management
Stateless AI boundary — all database writes are validated and committed only through the ASP.NET Core backend

architecture.role: Single entry gateway & source of truth
Persistence with row-level locking for reservations

agents.name: Requirement Discovery
agents.does: Extracts use-case, LKR budget and priorities without prematurely naming parts.

agents.name: Inventory Stock
agents.does: Checks live stock, suggests pin-compatible alternatives and places 15-minute reservation holds.

agents.name: PC Build & Compatibility
agents.does: Deterministic socket, DDR, form-factor and PSU headroom (TDP + 150 W) validation.

agents.name: Order Planning & Pricing
agents.does: Itemised LKR bills, coupon validation, delivery tiers and draft order proposals.

agents.name: After-Sales Service
agents.does: Troubleshooting trees, warranty checks and technician appointments (max 10 per day).

demo-note: The free-tier Render services spin down after 15 minutes idle — allow roughly 30–45 seconds for the first request.

demo-login.note: Public demo account listed in the repository README.

quality: xUnit + InMemory EF Core backend tests
GitHub Actions CI across all four tiers

why-i-made-this.simple: Modelled on the enthusiast computer retail industry — from a customer's custom rig to technician review, assembly and after-sales support.

principles.d: React and Flutter clients communicate exclusively with the ASP.NET Core Web API.
The Python AI microservice is internal — invoked only by AiAgentService.cs and never exposed to external networks.
All PostgreSQL writes are transactional via EF Core, with row-level locking during inventory reservations.
